name: Villalar de los Comuneros (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Villalar de los Comuneros (a pillory on red above two keys on blue).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were approved on 30 May 1997 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 20 June 1997; the arms are of Spanish shape, gules a pillory or masoned sable, on a base azure two keys or joined by chain links, with the royal crown of Spain. The flag is square, of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.
